latestVersion.changelog:
Maker Italiano — Initial Release

- Create Italian-language videos quickly from clips or images with easy text prompts.
- Automatic token and session setup for fast cloud-based processing.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 500MB.
- Exports high-quality 1080p MP4 videos, ready for Italian social platforms.
- Includes error handling, timeline summaries, credits checks, and status feedback.
- Optimized for content creators and marketers needing fast, no-skill-required Italian video production.
